subject: Evaluation gates orchestration — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA & retention timeline
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna@greenrock.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Warren <tom.w@greenrock.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Evaluation — security gates & timelines

Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. GreenRock is aligned to run a focused evaluation on Redwood for payment orchestration use cases. From our side the core gating items are: SOC 2 attestation (or evidence matrix), SIG/CAIQ responses, an agreed DPA with clear data retention windows, and an operational runbook for data access requests.

Can you confirm you can surface the MAP with milestone owners and target dates? I'm hoping to sync on a close-by date for procurement — ideally mid-May if we can get evidence in the next 3 weeks. Attaching our internal SIG questionnaire (PDF) and I'll loop Tom on procurement timing.

Best,
Anna
Anna Li
Head of Security, GreenRock Finance
anna@greenrock.com

Attachment: GreenRock-SIG-questions.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@greenrock.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation — security gates & timelines

Anna — thanks, great to connect.

We're able to map the evaluations into a short Mutual Action Plan. I attached a first-pass MAP (GR-MAP-v1.xlsx) that breaks milestones into: evidence intake (SOC 2 artifacts), SIG responses, DPA negotiation, and a final runbook walkthrough. High-level ask: can GreenRock commit to receiving SOC 2 artifact packages by 2027-04-16 so we can keep a mid-May procurement close? If not, share the earliest realistic window.

I'll loop Marissa for milestone ownership and Neha for technical intake. Quick notes in the MAP:
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report + control mappings; for controls that require artifact collection (e.g., incident logs, backup manifests) we'll list owners and delivery ETA.
- SIG/CAIQ: Marissa will coordinate answers and Neha will handle technical clarifications.
- DPA: Laura (legal) will send a redline once we have procurement items.
- Retention: propose default 90-day ephemeral cache + 1 year retained metadata; open to negotiation for regulated data classes.

Proposed next steps:
1) GreenRock confirms artifact delivery ETA (SOC 2 + SIG supporting docs)
2) Redwood shares final MAP and DPA redline
3) 30-min walkthrough (tech + security) next week to close open SIG clarifications

I can kick off that walkthrough — options on my side: Tue 4/6 10:00-11:00 or Wed 4/7 14:30-15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
 diego_fernandez@redwood.com

Attachment: GR-MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsm, 42KB)

Cc: Tom Warren <tom.w@greenrock.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation — security gates & timelines

Diego — thanks for the MAP. Quick answers:
- We can aim to deliver SOC 2 artifact package by 2027-04-15; our security operations team will pull the attachments and an evidence manifest.
- SIG/CAIQ: see attached PDF with baseline questions; we'll expect Redwood to flag any control gaps and provide compensating controls.
- DPA: procurement is fine with a standard DPA; Tom will review and will loop Laura (procurement/legal).

A walkthrough on Tue 4/6 10:00 PT works for us. Please include your technical lead for KV cache/data flow details — we need to confirm that transient tokens and customer identifiers are not persisted beyond the retention windows in the MAP.

Anna

Attachment: GreenRock-SIG-questions.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@greenrock.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed milestone sprint & owners (MAP)

Hi Anna / team — following Diego's MAP, I've put together a compact sprint with owners and dates (see inline). Goal is to give procurement a clean runway to mid-May close if GreenRock hits the SOC 2 evidence delivery date.

Key milestones (proposed):
- 2027-04-06: Technical walkthrough (Redwood tech + GreenRock security) — owner: Diego
- 2027-04-15: SOC 2 evidence intake complete — owner: GreenRock (Anna) / intake support: Neha
- 2027-04-18: SIG/CAIQ final Q&A closed — owner: Marissa
- 2027-04-21: DPA redline received by GreenRock — owner: Laura (Redwood Legal)
- 2027-04-25: Final commercial terms & DocuSign ready — owner: Marissa / Tom
- 2027-05-12: Target procurement signature/close

Retention specifics we propose here (for MAP clarity):
- Application request payloads: ephemeral cache, max 90 days unless otherwise scoped in DPA
- Full request logs (for billing/troubleshooting): retained 1 year, access role-based and logged
- Customer-provided PII in payloads: segregated, retention per DPA with options for shorter windows (30/90/365 days)

I've uploaded the milestone spreadsheet and a condensed SOC 2 artifact checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefG-MapDraft

Please confirm owners and if the dates are acceptable — if GreenRock needs more runway on the SOC 2 artifacts we can shift the close by one week.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment referenced in drive: MAP-milestones-20270404.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Warren <tom.w@greenrock.com>, Anna Li <anna@greenrock.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: DPA redline + final gate conditions for MAP

Tom / Anna — attaching Redwood's DPA redline (DPA-redline-Laura-Bennett-20270406.docx). High level notes:
1) Retention: we kept the MAP default (90-day cache / 1-year logs) and added configurable retention tiers for regulated classes; please flag any contractual retention windows you require and we'll bake into the DPA.
2) Audit logs & access: we propose Customer Audit Access with 30-day lookback in the UI and a 365-day exportable audit package for validated requests.
3) SOC 2: we'll provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report and a control mapping by 2027-04-12; where artifacts require system traces we will provide sample manifests and scopes.
4) SIG/CAIQ: we've started to answer baseline controls; Neha will host the technical portion of the walkthrough and will capture open items in a shared tracker.

Final gate language for the MAP (suggested):
- Security Acceptance: delivery of SOC 2 evidence package + completion of SIG Q&A (<= 3 open items requiring engineering work)
- Legal Acceptance: mutual execution of DPA with agreed retention windows
- Operational Acceptance: runbook walkthrough complete and confirmation of incident response SLA

I've also prepared a DocuSign envelope to speed signature once procurement confirms commercial terms: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/GR-DPA-2027

If GreenRock confirms SOC 2 artifact ETA (2027-04-15) and SIG walkthrough on 4/6, we are comfortable keeping the target close of 2027-05-12. If artifacts slip beyond 4/18 we should plan a one-week push to allow intake and legal review.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA-redline-Laura-Bennett-20270406.docx (docx, 38KB)
